narrative_note: Subarea covers the City of Stockholm and its municipal borders. Pure urban grid — predominantly cable, with a few overhead-line sections planned for removal. Distribution voltage 10 kV throughout. Regional grid: 220 kV feeds a 110 kV grid which in turn feeds some distribution substations connected at 33 kV; some distribution substations are fed directly from 220 kV and 110 kV. All produced electricity is consumed within the subarea.
